photos.name: confit-garlic-setup
photos.summary: Two containers of HEB pre-peeled garlic cloves in a dark loaf pan submerged in canola oil, ready for confit. Hill Country Fare canola oil bottle visible alongside flour bag.

photos.name: finished-swirl-buns-in-tin
photos.summary: 13 finished gochujang swirl buns — 12 in muffin tin plus 1 extra in separate loaf pan. Deep golden-brown with honey-soy glaze, black and white sesame seeds. Visible swirl pattern from cinnamon-roll style shaping. Some size variation and center caving on larger buns.
